messages.text: Hi, do you have Cetirizine 10mg in stock?
Yes, we have Cetirizine 10mg strips available at Samaleswari Medical Store. You can reserve them for pickup or upload your prescription.
Hello, do you dispense Azithromycin 500mg with doctor prescription?
Namaskar! Yes, we have Azithromycin 500mg in stock at Jagannath Medical Store, Gosala Chowk. Please upload a clear photo of your prescription and we will prepare it for counter pickup.
